rationale.conceptual: The task uses a standard DFT method (LDA) on published crystal structures; no novel algorithm or deep theory is required. It is a textbook-level computational exercise in solid-state physics.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves 3 sequential steps: structure preparation, SCF+band structure runs, and gap extraction. All steps are straightforward I/O and standard library calls, with no complex orchestration or fragile handoffs.
